The main takeaway from our work is that
a search engine can be built using a few basic techniques, and that there are many ways in which a search engine can perform better or worse.

the performance of a Web search engine is determined by the interplay of the various engine components, and that there are no simple rules of thumb that can be used to determine the best design for a given situation.
